title: New to Game Dev but excited

posts.author: Star_Anise
posts.body: Hello, I'm rgBLU and I'm mainly an artist and animator. Been inspired by older RPG Maker games like Ib and To the Moon and slowly dipping my toes into MZ and javascript. Hoping to debut a game in development one day but for now soaking in the forums and a lot of Youtube tutorials. Looking forward to chatting!

posts.author: MoonWolfV
posts.body: Welcome to the forums. I joined up here only yesterday and I've already found the others here friendly and helpful.

posts.author: Erif
posts.body: Welcome! We're here to help, don't hesitate to ask!

posts.author: Prescott
posts.body: Welcome to both of you newcomers! Enjoy your stay and happy game making

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
WELCOME!
Having a background in art and animation can be very helpful. And taking it slow and learning from recreating tutorials is a great idea. And learning JS is very useful too.
I was completely new to programming and game development about 2.5 years ago when I started with MZ and getting into this hobby was one of the best decisions of my life. And I like to think I have learned quite a bit.
Good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!
